title: Find the Longest Palindromic DNA Segment
real_world_story: A biological sequence analysis system examines a DNA strand to identify the longest segment that reads identically from both directions.

real_world_connection.input_represents: A DNA sequence obtained from a biological sample
real_world_connection.target_represents: The longest continuous DNA segment that is identical when read forward and backward
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Finding the longest palindromic substring within a biological sequence

problem_statement: Given a DNA sequence, find the longest contiguous substring that is a palindrome. A palindrome reads the same from left to right and right to left. Return the length of the longest palindromic substring.
task: Analyze the DNA sequence and return the length of its longest palindromic segment.
input_format: The first line contains the DNA sequence.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the length of the longest palindromic substring.
constraints: DNA sequences contain only the characters A, C, G, and T

examples.explanation: The complete sequence 'ATCGCTA' is a palindrome, so the longest palindromic substring has length 7.
The longest palindromic substring is 'CGC', which has length 3.

expected_algorithm.name: Longest Palindromic Substring
expected_algorithm.reason: The DNA sequence may contain palindromic segments of different lengths, so expanding around centers or using dynamic programming can identify the longest continuous palindrome.

hint: Consider every position as a possible center of a palindrome.
Expand outward while the characters on both sides match.
Check both odd-length and even-length palindromes and keep the maximum length.
real_world_takeaway: Palindromic DNA sequences can be important in biological sequence analysis because certain genetic structures and recognition sites contain symmetrical patterns.
